meta.author: OpenMedia
meta.summary: Hides app banners, sign-in pop-up, ads, Reels, Stories, columns, tabs, counts, buttons, suggestions; blurs or hides videos, avatars
meta.notes:
**2026-11-13 additions** (m.facebook.com Bloks, iPhone UA 390x844, headless Chrome, logged out, /watch/): `videos` and `profile-pictures` are choice options (Show, Blur, Hide).
- **LIVE** on /watch/: `[data-log-comp-type$="ufi_like_button"]`, `ufi_comment_button` and `ufi_share_button` 8 each (24 together; the attribute is language-independent); `[role="button"][aria-label$=" reactions"]` 8 (English label, the counter is part of it); `[data-type="video"]` 8 (one per video card); `[aria-label$="Profile Picture"] img` 5 and `[aria-label^="Unseen story from"] img` 3 (English labels). `[data-log-comp-type="feed_post:ufi_blingbar"]` was in one server dump of /watch/ and absent after hydration in the next load: kept as a harmless extra.
- **SOURCE**: the three suggested-section rules come from mustafamohsen's Facebook uBO filters (gist, undated): `[aria-posinset]` units that link to `/friends/`, `/groups/discover/` or carry `aria-label="Suggested pages"`. They are desktop-feed rules; the Bloks feed was not reachable logged out. `[data-pagelet^="FeedUnit"] video` in `videos` is desktop INFERRED.
- Fixtures: `desktop-feed.html` is hand-written (logged-out desktop is only a login form); the new Bloks hooks were added to `public-watch.html` with the attributes seen live.
- Not verified: any logged-in page, Marketplace, Gaming, the Bloks feed. No selector for ads by label (Facebook splits `Sponsored` into one-letter spans).

**Earlier checks**

Facebook serves iPhone user agents the Bloks layout on m.facebook.com (www redirects there); desktop selectors (aria-posinset, role=feed, hashed x* classes) match nothing, and the generic wbloks_* and m classes sit on almost every element. LIVE (logged out): get-app-bar matched the 42 px banner on the login page, open-app-button matched the sticky button on public pages, full-experience-sheet matched the one dialog on /watch/ and /reel/ (its aria-label starts "Get the full experience"; hiding every aria-modal dialog would also hide logged-in comment and share sheets), reels-profile-tab matched on a page's tab strip, reels-chip matched the "Reels , 2 of 5" chip, reels-thumbnails matched the "View reel video from ..." buttons. On /reel/ the whole page is the wall, so hiding the sheet is cosmetic. unlock-scroll is scoped to pages that hold the sheet because Bloks may rely on body overflow elsewhere. SOURCE only, not seen live (logged-in): stories-row (kurtnettle/uBO-filters-fb). Labels are English only. No CSS selector was found for suggested or sponsored posts on Bloks, so there is no option for them. DESKTOP (macOS Safari UA): www.facebook.com serves the full React site, not the Bloks layout above. Logged out it is only the login form, so every desktop rule is INFERRED from data-pagelet and aria-label attributes (hand-written fixture desktop-feed.html): sponsored-feed-posts, sponsored-right-rail, stories-pagelet, reels-feed-posts, reels-nav-link, right-column, left-column, video-tab-links.
